image_description: A close-up, low-light photograph of a metallic, cylindrical lighter (resembling a Zippo or similar windproof design) being held by a human hand. The lighter has a brushed metal finish with visible engravings/logos on the side. A small flame is visible at the top, emerging from the mechanism. The background is dark and out of focus, with a hint of yellow fabric or object behind the hand.

The context of being held in a hand and the presence of a flame confirms its function as a portable ignition source.
